messages:
tara: Heads up: security scan found an unintended SUID binary in our base image used by runtime-graph. It's in /usr/bin/graphctl. digest: sha256:feedface0000abcd
ben: Which pipeline produced that image?
tara: It was produced by the nightly pipeline (pipeline id: nightly-49). Link: https://artifacts.example/images/9001
oz: cosign verify output?
tara: ```
$ cosign verify gcr.io/redwood/runtime-graph:nightly-2026-03-22
Verified OK : sha256:feedface0000abcd
Signed by: nightly-builder@redwood
Key: projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-ops/cryptoKeyVersions/5
```
audit-bot: image-scan: HIGH severity: SUID found at /usr/bin/graphctl; world-writable directory /usr/lib/graph/plugins flagged.
ben: We need to stop auto-promotions. Add digest to denylist and revoke signing key binding from nightly-builder until we fix.
tara: Denylist updated via ops-bot.
ops-bot: denylist updated: sha256:feedface0000abcd added (TTL 72h)
secops: I'll open a high-priority ticket to rotate the key and run a forensics snapshot of the builder instance. Could be compromised or just a bad base.
oz: Quick mitigation: rebuild base with distroless and explicit USER 65532, strip suid bits in build. Also lock down builder image-outputs to not preserve permissions from source checkout.
ben: Add cosign attestation to the build: cosign attest --predicate <build-metadata.json> --key gcpkms://... That way we have verifiable provenance showing pipeline id and commit.
tara: I'll schedule a 30-min incident sync in 10 min. We should include SRE and infra to check builder IAM.
ben: Also check GCS bucket ACLs where artifacts are stored. If builds were tampered with, we need to rotate service account credentials.
oz: For the runtime, implement a container prestart hook that runs `stat -c '%A %n' /usr/bin/graphctl` and logs audit event if SUID present, then fail start. Add an alert to Paging with low-severity for the canary clusters.
audit-bot: Suggested checklist: 1) denylist digest, 2) revoke builder KMS access, 3) snapshot builder vm, 4) rebuild non-root, 5) sign with rotated KMS key, 6) export audit logs to security project.
secops: Ticket SEC-3457 created. I'll assign primary to tara and ben for rebuild.
tara: thanks. I'll update after the evidence snapshot is complete.
ben: quick commands for rotation:
```
# rotate key version
gcloud kms keys versions create --key prod-ops --location global --keyring images
# sign new image
cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/prod-ops gcr.io/redwood/runtime-graph:nightly-2026-03-22-rebuild
```

oz: Remember to add IAM condition on the new key: allow only ephemeral signer SA when request.auth.claim.pipeline=="nightly" and require approvals for promotion.
tara: meeting in 10. will post minutes here. closing for now."
